note: Oil rebounded on 13 November: Brent rose to about $95.44/bbl and WTI to about $88.12/bbl, up roughly 3% on the day, while TTF firmed to about €91.40/MWh. UKMTO and JMIC reported four tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and the UAE coast within about 48 hours, including a crude tanker set ablaze off Ras Al Khaimah on Nov 11, reversing some of the prior week's pullback. Qatar's LNG loadings have climbed to roughly half the pre-war pace (Bloomberg/Kpler), even as Poland's Orlen became the first QatarEnergy customer to cancel a long-term LNG contract over the disruption.
